annotations.ck_tl_ann_live_verdict.def: CHECK ((tombstone OR (kind <> 'verdict'::text) OR (verdict IS NOT NULL)))

annotations.ck_tl_ann_right.def: CHECK (((verdict IS DISTINCT FROM 'right'::text) OR ((quote IS NULL) AND (span_id IS NULL) AND (field IS NULL))))

annotations.ck_tl_ann_turn_field.def: CHECK (((span_id IS NOT NULL) OR (field IS NULL) OR (field = ANY (ARRAY['question'::text, 'answer'::text]))))

annotations.ck_tl_ann_wrong.def: CHECK ((tombstone OR (verdict IS DISTINCT FROM 'wrong'::text) OR ((btrim(COALESCE(note, ''::text)) <> ''::text) AND (quote IS NOT NULL) AND (field IS NOT NULL) AND (quote_occurrence IS NOT NULL))))

eval_cases.ck_eval_cases_twin.def: CHECK (((golden_case_id IS NOT NULL) OR (status = ANY (ARRAY['proposed'::text, 'retired'::text]))))

golden_cases.golden_cases_followups_chec.def: CHECK ( CASE WHEN (jsonb_typeof(followups) = 'array'::text) THEN (jsonb_array_length(followups) <= 5) ELSE false END)

golden_sets.golden_sets_kind_shape.def: CHECK ((((kind = 'regression'::text) = (version = 0)) AND ((kind = 'regression'::text) OR ((source_filename IS NOT NULL) AND (source_sha256 IS NOT NULL) AND (case_count >= 1)))))

judges.judges_check.def: CHECK ((((kind = 'llm'::text) AND (model IS NOT NULL) AND (prompt_text IS NOT NULL) AND (check_key IS NULL)) OR ((kind = 'code'::text) AND (check_key IS NOT NULL) AND (check_version IS NOT NULL) AND (prompt_text IS NULL))))

judges.judges_check1.def: CHECK (((status = 'draft'::text) OR ((frozen_at IS NOT NULL) AND (stop_reason IS NOT NULL))))

lab_label_cells.ck_tl_lab_label_cells_au.def: CHECK (((author_id IS NOT NULL) OR (author_email IS NOT NULL)))

lab_runs.ck_tl_lab_runs_production.def: CHECK (((kind <> 'production'::text) OR ((owner_user_id IS NOT NULL) AND (run_day IS NOT NULL))))

labels.ck_tl_labels_from_proposal.def: CHECK (((source <> ALL (ARRAY['accepted_suggestion'::text, 'rejected_suggestion'::text, 'accepted_label_proposal'::text])) OR (proposal_id IS NOT NULL)))

labels.ck_tl_labels_open_code.def: CHECK (((source <> 'human_open_code'::text) OR ((annotation_id IS NOT NULL) AND present)))

labels.ck_tl_labels_tombstone.def: CHECK (((NOT tombstone) OR ((present IS NULL) AND (source = 'human_structured_label'::text))))

modes.ck_tl_modes_not_self.def: CHECK (((merged_into IS DISTINCT FROM id) AND (split_from IS DISTINCT FROM id)))

proposals.ck_tl_prop_cell_target.def: CHECK (((kind = 'group'::text) OR ((turn_id IS NOT NULL) AND (organization_id IS NOT NULL) AND (mode_id IS NOT NULL))))

step_labels.ck_tl_step_labels_live.def: CHECK ((tombstone OR (label IS NOT NULL) OR (note IS NOT NULL)))
